title: Mutt Carey and the eggshell mute; replacing Zutty at the Elite
summary: He worked with Mutt Carey, who used half an eggshell in his horn, and took over from Zutty Singleton.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition
